For a 25–50 ms goal

Players need a nearby Australian game server and a short network route to it. Selecting Oceania filters matchmaking; it does not move the existing server. Cloudflare’s Oceania placement hint is best effort.

Solo Free Play can run locally

For practice without network delay, return to the main menu and choose Training → Free Play → Start Free Play. That runs on your own device. Server Free Play still makes a round trip, even with only one player.

Results stay on this page. The test does not collect your IP address, profile, friends, invite codes or credentials. Background tabs, VPNs, Wi-Fi congestion and routing changes can affect samples. This test does not change your computer or your network settings.
